subject: Targeting senescence: the new precision arsenal against aging
script: From Agewell Brief: Targeting senescence: the new precision arsenal against aging. A systematic review maps senolytics, senomorphics, and metabolic mimetics—plus AI-driven discovery—to redefine healthspan. Senolytics like dasatinib + quercetin clear senescent cells. Senomorphics such as rapamycin suppress the SASP phenotype. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
